sentences.text: Both the claimants have preferred these appeals, against NC: 2023:KHC:37690 award passed in MVC.No.5098/2010, MFA.No.11001/2012 is filed and against award passed in MVC.No.5137/2010 MFA.No.11002/2012 is filed.

It is the case of the claimants that on 30.05.2010 at about 3.30 p.m. both the claimants who were husband and wife were traveling in a motor cycle, when they reached near mother daily circle, all of a sudden Indica Car came in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the motor cycle of the claimant.
Due to the impact, both the claimants fell down and sustained grievous injuries in the accident.
Immediately they were admitted to Hospital and they spent huge amount for treatment.

When it comes to issue of negligence and liability, the Tribunal had held that accident had taken place because of the rash and negligent driving of the driver of the offending vehicle, as the driver was not having effective driving license to drive the vehicle, the insurance company was exonerated from the liability and held that owner alone is liable to pay the compensation.

When it comes to compensation in respect of NC: 2023:KHC:37690 MVC.No.5098/2010 i.e., husband who had sustained one fracture laceration 5 cm x 5 cm muscle deep present with underlying fracture displaced of right medial malleolus over the right ankle joint.

Under the head of pain and suffering,
the court below had granted an amount of Rs.20,000/-, towards medical expenses and conveyance,
food and attendant charges an amount of Rs.40,000/- was granted, towards loss of income during treatment period an amount of Rs.8,000/- was granted, towards loss of future income, though the doctor opined that there is disability but the court below considered disability is not affecting the future prospects of the claimant, had not considered any amount under the said head.
Towards loss of amenities and unhappiness an amount of Rs.15,000/- was granted, considering the disability as stated by the doctor.
Towards future medical expenses for removal of the implants another surgery was required, an amount of Rs.8,000/- was granted.
Altogether compensation of an amount of Rs.91,000/- was awarded in respect of husband.

When it comes to the wife, i.e., NC:
2023:KHC:37690 MVC.No.5137/2010, she had sustained multiple fracture abrasion on the right side of the face and there was a head injury.
Considering the injuries, the court below had granted Sri Shivakumar vs Sri M V Girish on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174655688/

when it comes to loss of earning during the laid up period the court below had considered Rs.3,000/- as income and for three months an amount of Rs.9,000/- was granted.
Though the doctor had deposed that she had sustained 21% disability to the whole body, the court below had not granted any amount under the head of loss of future income.
Towards loss of amenities and unhappiness an amount of Rs.20,000/- was granted.
Altogether compensation of an amount of Rs.99,000/- was granted in respect of the wife.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in case of husband, he had sustained fracture injury and also the disability, the court below had failed to consider and had not granted any amount under the head of loss of NC: 2023:KHC:37690 future income due to disability.
It is submitted even towards monthly income also, the court below had taken only Rs.4,000/- which is on the lower side.

According to the claimant, he was earning more than an amount of Rs.10,000/-
per month.
It is submitted that compensation that was granted was on the lower side.
Further on the liability, the learned counsel submits that driver of the offending vehicle was having the driving license.
The court below observed that it was not effective valid driving license and absolved insurance company.
He submits that even for violation of any of conditions of the policy, the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation.
Then coming to the claim in MVC.No.5137/2010 learned counsel for the claimant submits that the court below had taken income at Rs.3,000/- which is on the lower side.
Apart from that, as per the doctor when she had sustained 21% disability, the court below had not considered the same and there is no discussion in this regard.

They have examined the doctor and the doctor has categorically deposed that there is difficulty in memory not able to NC: 2023:KHC:37690 express herself, which would have an impact on her future life, this aspect would have been taken into consideration.
Even in her case also, under the head of pain and suffering, the amount that was granted was not reasonable.

4. Learned counsel for the insurance company submits that offending vehicle was a car and the court below observed that on perusal of Ex.R-6 it is evident that the driver was having license to drive LMV Cab only from 21.02.2011, whereas the accident had taken place on 30.05.2010.

The court also observed that he was having light motor vehicle as well as license to drive three wheeler cab, but, he was not having driving license to drive commercial vehicle and the vehicle was handed over to the driver who was not having effective driving license.
Learned counsel submits that as there was no effective driving license to the driver of the offending vehicle, the Tribunal had rightly exonerated the insurance company.

He also submits that court below had not granted any NC:
2023:KHC:37690 compensation on the ground of disability as stated by the doctor as it had no impact on the future prospects of the claimants.
He submits that no grounds are made out for enhancement of the compensation as well.
5. Having heard the learned counsels on either side, perused the entire material on record.
First and the foremost issue is with regard to the liability.
The court below had exonerated the insurance company from liability on the ground that the driver was not having a effective driving license.

In the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in case of NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED -VS- SWARAN SINGH AND OTHERS 1 still the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation and recover the same from the owner of the vehicle.
